entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, ID 401. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I hope you can help. I bought something a while ago, and I need to return it. I was looking at the website and I'm just so overwhelmed by all the rules.
Of course, I can certainly help clarify things for you. What item are you calling about today?
It's a helmet. I ordered it for my husband, but the color is just... not right. It looked different online. I'm pretty sure the box is still unopened.
I understand. Getting the right gear is important. Can I get your order number to pull up the details?
Yes, it's... VF-86753. Honestly, the return page was so confusing. Can't you just help me? I don't know what to do.
That's exactly what I'm here for, no need to worry. Let me look up order VF-86753... I see it right here. The helmet was delivered about 57 days ago, is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. Is that too long? Oh, I knew I should have called sooner.
Not at all. Let me just check our policy. One moment... Okay, I've confirmed it. Our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window.
Oh, really? So I can send it back? That's such a relief.

Absolutely. Ensuring you have gear you're confident in is key for safety, so we're happy to process this for you. I've just approved the return in our system. I am emailing a pre-paid shipping label to you right now. Do you have a printer?
Yes, I do! Thank you so much, Diana. You've made this so simple.

You're very welcome. Just attach that label to the original box and drop it at your local post office. Once it arrives back at our warehouse, we'll issue a full refund. Was there anything else I could assist with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful holiday.
